WITH batters_with_awards AS (
  SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) as count_awards
  FROM player_award pa
  JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.bats
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as num_groups,
    SUM(count_awards) as total_awards
  FROM batters_with_awards
)
SELECT 
  ba.bats,
  ba.count_awards,
  CAST(ba.count_awards AS FLOAT) / s.total_awards as share,
  CAST(ba.count_awards AS FLOAT) / s.total_awards - 1.0 / s.num_groups as above_average
FROM batters_with_awards ba
CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE CAST(ba.count_awards AS FLOAT) / s.total_awards > 1.0 / s.num_groups
ORDER BY share DESC
